cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we go on for the skating qualifier, name the outcome we haven't prepared for. We need a complete plan, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to put failure in your head.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's already there. Saying 'failure' isn't specific enough. Finish this: 'We might not...'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Qualify. I'd still want to skate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Keep that promise. Now say what you think I'm afraid you'd do if we didn't qualify.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 tries to avoid frightening A; B4 names nonqualification and adds loyalty, which directly motivates A5's deeper question.

relationship.evidence: B4 contributes reassurance as a partner with an ongoing choice about skating together.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's promise to expose the next vulnerable possibility without naming it first.
